generalRules.title: Punctuality
generalRules.desc: All teams must report 15 mins before their scheduled time.

generalRules.title: Match Points
generalRules.desc: 10 points will be awarded for winning each match in a Best-of-3 format.

generalRules.title: Rule Violation Penalty
generalRules.desc: If any player is found to have broken the tournament rules, the team will be penalised with a deduction of 20 points (-20 points).

participationRules.title: Player Injury
participationRules.desc: In case of a player injury during any sport, no team will be allowed to replace the injured player with another team player. For Badminton, Pickleball, Table Tennis and Carrom, the team must forfeit the match in case of an injury. In Football and Tug of War, the team must continue playing with the remaining number of players.

participationRules.title: Participation Quota
participationRules.desc: It is mandatory for every team to ensure that each player gets to play a minimum of 1 sport against every opposing team. Only after all players have completed their 1-sport quota against that team may the remaining available spots be filled by allowing players to play a 2nd sport. If spots still remain after every player has completed 2 sports, the remaining spots may be filled by allowing players to play a 3rd sport.

rules.title: Maximum Score
rules.desc: At 14-14, the pair scoring the 15th point wins

rules.title: Scoring
rules.desc: Rally point - every rally results in a point

rules.title: Service
rules.desc: Serve diagonally into the opponent's service court. The serve must be hit with an upward racket motion, contacting the shuttlecock below the waist line.

rules.title: Goalkeeper
rules.desc: Must roll the ball underarm or pass with feet. Overarm throwing or drop kicks are not allowed.

rules.title: Scoring
rules.desc: Rally point - every rally results in a point

rules.title: Double Bounce Rule
rules.desc: The ball must bounce once on each side before volleying is allowed.

rules.title: Non-Volley Zone
rules.desc: No volleying in the 7-foot zone closest to the net (the Kitchen).

rules.title: Deuce
rules.desc: At 10-10, players alternate serves. First pair to gain a 2-point lead wins.

rules.title: Service
rules.desc: Serve diagonally into the opponent's service court.

rules.title: Fouls
rules.desc: Striker foul results in a penalty (due point).
